title: Belated New Year wishes
content:
Hi guys,

Forgive me for being a bit too active here. Normally, I don’t like exposing myself in social media and I’m foreign to all the bragging that goes on in Instagram etc But this community is different: it feels genuine and comfortable and I’m so happy to be a part of it!

Nope, I’m not a 3D designer. Although my initial education that I got 30 years ago (yep, I’m nearly 51) was in fashion, I’ve been out of the industry for so long that I don’t dare to even consider myself a part of it. But I endlessly admire **all** and **every single one of you** for your desire to learn and ability to create. And I wish you all endless inspiration, strength, persistence in learning and achieving the new heights in 2025!

Sending you all tight hugs 🤗

Anna

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/68046ee39ecf4e3a86d6419eaf641545/images/80cfe23478ba4d3bb4e3e93231886921IMG_3115.jpeg)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: We’re so glad to have you here! Here’s to an inspiring and creative 2025! Big hugs! 🤗
content_description: A warm and encouraging message celebrating genuine community connection, creativity, and inspiration for personal growth in 2025.
